# WikiHouse Skylark 250 M — certified iter2 construction
# Params: W, H_WALL, RISE, D, DOOR_CX, DOOR_W, WIN_L_CX, WIN_R_CX, WIN_W, WIN_SILL
H_TOTAL=H_WALL+RISE; DOOR_H=2100.; WIN_H=WIN_W; Y_WIN=-5.
# Wall box (cream)
sc.doc.Objects.AddBrep(rg.Box(rg.Plane.WorldXY,rg.Interval(0,W),rg.Interval(0,D),rg.Interval(0,H_WALL)).ToBrep())
# GABLE roof: triangle extruded by D (NOT hip — horizontal eave on long sides)
ext=rg.Extrusion.Create(rg.PolylineCurve([rg.Point3d(0,0,H_WALL),rg.Point3d(W,0,H_WALL),rg.Point3d(W/2,0,H_TOTAL),rg.Point3d(0,0,H_WALL)]),D,True)
if ext: sc.doc.Objects.AddBrep(ext.ToBrep(True))
# Opening helper
def rect_srf(cx,z0,w,h,color,y=Y_WIN):
    L=rs.AddLayer(f'WH_{int(cx)}_{int(z0)}',color)
    rs.CurrentLayer(L)
    pts=[(cx-w/2,y,z0),(cx+w/2,y,z0),(cx+w/2,y,z0+h),(cx-w/2,y,z0+h),(cx-w/2,y,z0)]
    c=rs.AddPolyline(pts); s=rs.AddPlanarSrf([c]); rs.DeleteObject(c); return s
# Eave band
rect_srf(W/2,H_WALL-40.,W,80.,System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(55,50,45),y=-3.)
# GF openings: window | door (center) | window
win_c=System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(40,85,140)
door_c=System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(30,60,115)
rect_srf(WIN_L_CX,WIN_SILL,WIN_W,WIN_H,win_c)
rect_srf(DOOR_CX,0.,DOOR_W,DOOR_H,door_c)
rect_srf(WIN_R_CX,WIN_SILL,WIN_W,WIN_H,win_c)
